evidence.claim: Six self-written loopback cases observed response-loss duplicate commits, ID-only non-deduplication, keyed retry behavior, server commit after client timeout, lock-serialized concurrent deduplication and parameter-binding necessity.

source_refs.locator: server_cases; six original_loopback_server_experiment cases repeated 3 times

limitations: In-memory self-written JSON-line server; not HTTP, ACP, ASP, provider SDK or upstream harness execution.
No durable storage, restart, replication, tenant authentication, key expiry or production exactly-once guarantee tested.

evidence.claim: After one owned process exited successfully, the OS pipe did not reach EOF while another owned process retained its write FD. Explicitly releasing that holder produced EOF.
limitations: Actual local POSIX pipe only; no Kubernetes, Docker or SSH execution.

evidence.claim: A local PTY explicitly configured with OPOST/ONLCR and shared stdout/stderr produced combined CRLF output, unlike separately captured pipe streams.
limitations: Configuration-dependent local Linux observation; not a claim about every PTY default.

evidence.claim: Splitting the UTF-8 bytes of 结果✓ into single-byte chunks corrupted per-chunk replacement decoding, while a standard-library incremental decoder recovered the original text.
limitations: A controlled decoder test, not an observed upstream adapter bug.

evidence.claim: RFC 9110 section 9.2.2 defines idempotency by intended effect and limits automatic non-idempotent retry unless semantics are known idempotent or original non-application can be detected.
limitations: The lab is not an HTTP conformance implementation.
